definition.title: Find the errors your users search for
definition.description: Read the connected repository for the error messages your product shows users, check which your docs already answer, and get a ranked list of pages to write with the cause and fix from the code, ready to add to Plan upcoming content as a context file. It never writes pages, opens pull requests or estimates search volume.

prerequisites.reason: The Code map's user-facing surfaces tell the run which directories users reach, so reading starts there instead of guessing.
When a ranked query or error code appears in the keyword plan, its observed demand is copied with the run id; otherwise demand is reported as unmeasured, never estimated.
The audit's crawled page list names live pages that may already answer an error, which content.plan needs to choose between a new page and an update.

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: A module, package, or surface to read first, such as the public API client or the CLI. Leave empty to read the user-facing surfaces evenly.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How much of the repository to read before ranking.

self_hosted.title: Do people run this product themselves?
self_hosted.description: Turn this on for open-source or self-hosted products, where setup and configuration errors reach real users rather than only your own team.

max_opportunities.title: Ranked opportunities
max_opportunities.description: How many page-worthy errors to carry into the ranked table. The report stays small enough to be a content.plan context file.

docs_paths.title: Optional docs locations
docs_paths.description: Repository directories that hold public documentation, such as docs or content/help. Leave empty to discover them.
